channel.title: MITRE Corporation — recent CVEs
channel.description: Most recent CVEs assigned by MITRE Corporation (mitre).

item.title: CVE-2026-106589 · 2.9 LOW
item.description: In sshd in OpenSSH through 10.6, in certain environments such as QNX 6 and SCO OpenServer 5, sshd-session can unexpectedly have root privileges. This is related to the GatewayPorts and StreamLocalForwarding configuration options, and lack of support…

item.title: CVE-2026-106588 · 3.1 LOW
item.description: In sshd in OpenSSH through 10.6, use of the macOS 27 (or later) SDK has the side effect of loss of sandboxing, which is potentially unexpected.

item.title: CVE-2026-106587 · 3.6 LOW
item.description: In sshd in OpenSSH before 10.6, the value "none" for a configuration option is sometimes interpreted as a filename but was intended to mean that a feature is disabled.

item.title: CVE-2026-106586 · 2.5 LOW
item.description: In sshd in OpenSSH before 10.6, the restrict keyword (in authorized_keys) was supposed to be applicable to tunnel forwarding but was not, a different vulnerability than CVE-2026-73283.

item.title: CVE-2026-106585 · 6.5 MEDIUM 🌩️
item.description: In sshd and ssh in OpenSSH before 10.6, there is no check for whether the maximum packet length is exceeded during decompression of highly compressed data.

item.title: CVE-2026-106584 · 2.5 LOW
item.description: In ssh-keygen in OpenSSH before 10.6, certificates could have incorrect expiration times because of Daylight Saving mishandling. There can be a slightly more severe effect on users in certain Antarctic locations.

item.title: CVE-2026-106582 · 3.7 LOW 🌩️
item.description: In sshd and ssh in OpenSSH before 10.6, an LZ77 dictionary coder can be used even though this is contraindicated by the arXiv 2609.07709 "Crossing the Streams" findings.

item.title: CVE-2026-106555 · 2.2 LOW
item.description: In sshd in OpenSSH before 10.6, GSSAPIAuthentication authentication state can incorrectly be persisted across authentication attempts.

item.title: CVE-2026-106553 · 2.2 LOW
item.description: In sshd in OpenSSH before 10.6, credentials can incorrectly persist after failure of a GSSAPIAuthentication authentication attempt.

item.title: CVE-2026-106552 · 4.2 MEDIUM 🌩️
item.description: In sftp in OpenSSH before 10.6, a server can trigger directory traversal (causing files to be written to unintended locations) during a recursive copy operation.

item.title: CVE-2026-95153 · 4.9 MEDIUM
item.description: An issue in Bludit CMS 3.22.0 allows a remote attacker to obtain sensitive information via the /admin/ajax/clippy and /admin/ajax/save-as-draft endpoints

item.title: CVE-2026-77178 · 9.1 CRITICAL 🌩️ 👻
item.description: Oracle VM VirtualBox before 7.2.8 allows guest OS users to cause an out-of-bounds write in the host OS in pcnetReceiveNoSync in DevPCNet.cpp in the PCNet (Am79C970A) network device model.

item.title: CVE-2025-71383
item.description: Dbit WIFI4 N300 1.0.0 devices allow the management interface to be crashed via a request (from the local Wi-Fi network) that lacks a /api/login username or password field. This occurs because of an error in a JSON parser.

item.title: CVE-2025-45871
item.description: LogicalDOC Enterprise up to and for 9.1.1 is vulnerable to blind SQL injection in the WorkflowsDataServlet component, allowing authenticated user to manipulate SQL queries via crafted workflow template name.

item.title: CVE-2026-105314 · 7.5 HIGH
item.description: Papermerge 3.5.3 allows remote code execution by a standard user via directory traversal in a /api/documents/upload call. A Python .pth file can be written to site-packages, and its code is executed upon the next start of the Python interpreter.

item.description: In Bacularis v1.0.0 - 6.5.1 when adding a new pool, the LabelFormat field allows for a Cross Site Scripting (XSS) payload.

item.description: OpenAPV before 1.1.1.0 has a read_bitstream heap-based buffer overflow.

item.title: CVE-2026-105080 · 9.9 CRITICAL
item.description: In ConvertX before 0.19.0, converters/calibre.ts does not block recipe files, and instead passes them to the ebook-convert program from Calibre. This affects executable code in a .recipe or .downloaded_recipe file.

item.title: CVE-2026-105048 · 4 MEDIUM 🌩️
